# Your data

## Where is my data stored?

In this browser: IndexedDB for content, local storage for preferences. There is no account, no
server and no background upload.

## Does the app work offline?

Yes. The manual and this FAQ are bundled with the application.

## What happens if I clear my browser data?

Everything this app stored is gone — content and preferences. There is no copy anywhere else, which
is the point.

## How do I delete everything?

**Settings → Privacy and data → Delete local data.** It clears the content and keeps your
preferences. To put the preferences back to their defaults too, use **Reset settings** — that one
keeps your content.

## Is anything sent to a third party?

No. No analytics, no remote fonts, no CDN scripts, no external APIs. The production build is checked
for unintended third-party requests before every release.

## What does "Pro" mean? Do I have to pay?

No. All features are currently free. The Pro view shows the entitlement status; purchases are not
enabled in this version.

## Can I use the app on another device?

Not automatically — the data lives in this browser. Moving it needs an export, which this version
does not have.
